source_refs.note: Conservation of Momentum: a main subheading of 2.9 Elastic collision in two dimensions, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 44-44.

blocks.text: Collision se pehle projectile ka momentum m₁v⃗₁i hai aur target ka momentum zero. Collision ke baad projectile (mass m₁, velocity v⃗₁f) ka momentum m₁v⃗₁f hai aur target (mass m₂, velocity v⃗₂f) ka m₂v⃗₂f. Projectile ke final momentum ke components m₁v⃗₁f cos θ₁ aur m₁v⃗₁f sin θ₁ hain; isi tarah target ke components m₂v⃗₂f cos θ₂ aur m₂v⃗₂f sin θ₂.

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁i - m₁v₁f cos θ₁ = m₂v₂f cos θ₂   (2.34)

blocks.text: y-axis ke saath momentum conservation (shuru mein y-momentum zero tha; ek body oopar aur doosri neeche jati hai, is liye minus):

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
0 = m₁v₁f sin θ₁ - m₂v₂f sin θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂   (2.35)
